start.observation: An ordinary center tap changed the title screen into the ready prompt; a second center tap launched the saucer and its visible thrust beam.

agency.normalInput: Repeated taps at roughly 350 ms intervals
agency.observation: Repeated taps visibly carried the saucer into the first gate corridor, while zero input remained on the animated home screen.

restart.observation: A gate collision reached the game-over state, and a subsequent ordinary tap returned to ready and launched a second playable run.

start.observation: The final PlayDrop-hosted build entered gameplay from ordinary tap input on portrait, landscape, and desktop.

agency.observation: All three final tape captures showed the saucer advancing and flapping through the monolith corridor, visibly distinct from their home-screen idle captures.

restart.observation: The final tape reached a stable collision state and completed a second playable run without a runtime crash on all three declared surfaces.
